Post 1

ASX barely moved — down 2.80pts to 8,847.30 — but beneath the surface, tech surged while energy collapsed. The index sits 4.83% off its 52-week high. Flat headline, violent rotation underneath. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

📈 Info Tech +2.36% led all sectors. 📉 Energy -2.45% was the session's punching bag. Consumer Discretionary -1.53% added to the pain. Two very different markets trading inside one flat index. #ASX #energy #tech

Post 3

NXT surged +9.39% to AUD 6.29 — the session's standout. Data centre demand continues to command a premium. REH shed -8.82% to AUD 15.62, the sharpest single-stock drop on the day. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,743.68/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7037. Silver AUD 76.64/oz. Platinum AUD 2,182.51/oz. Materials sector gained +1.07%, metals pricing providing a floor. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5

Watch energy. The sector fell -2.45% today and is carrying momentum into tomorrow. Does oil stabilise or does the selling deepen? Where do you see energy heading into week's end — buyers step in or more downside? #energy #ASX #ausbiz
